build_QformerLayer_self_attention: build a QformerLayer with self-attention only by setting has_cross_attention to False
build_QformerLayer_cross_attention: build a QformerLayer with cross-attention by providing dim_kv and setting has_cross_attention to True
build_QformerEncoder: build a QformerEncoder with multiple Qformer layers and configurable cross-attention frequency
build_QformerEmbedding: build a QformerEmbedding module with token and position embeddings for a given vocab size
test_QformerLayer_forward: test the QformerLayer forward pass with past key-value caching and query length parameters
